svg.aria-label: KaBiS — Personal project. Board-exam review in TypeScript on React 19, Express, MySQL and Docker: mock exams built to the official Tables of Specifications, an LLM ingestion pipeline gated by server-side validation, ~46% cross-source overlap deduplicated, and question variants re-randomised on every attempt.
